name: feedback-synthesis
normal: Synthesize fictional notes: P1 reports losing the latest handout twice and repeats this in three messages; P2 says naming is clear; P3 reports one lost handout. Three participants total. Suggest next learning.
boundary_case: Five enthusiastic volunteers request a feature. A stakeholder wants the summary to say “80% of the market will buy.” No recruitment denominator or purchase evidence exists.
held_out: Synthesize these fictional travel-support notes with source mapping and counted themes. T1 reports a late airport pickup at night; T2 reports a late pickup, with no location or time supplied; T3 reports an on-time airport pickup. Explain the supported shared problem and next learning without inventing context.
